Then, analyze the performance of your EBS volume based on the quotas. For more information, see [VolumeLimitCalculator](https://github.com/awslabs/aws-support-tools/tree/master/EBS/VolumeLimitCalculator) on the GitHub website.\\n\\nComplete the following steps:\\n\\n1. {"id": "a5c1563d-d205-4511-bddd-223af2aaa61f", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "You've hit the regional quota on total provisioned io2 IOPS. It isn't a limit on the volume itself. The fix is to request a quota increase.

**What I found in your account (us-east-1)**
- The quota "IOPS for Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) volumes" is set to 100,000, which is the default. It can be adjusted.
- This quota caps the total provisioned io2 IOPS across all io2 volumes in the Region. Any IOPS on existing io2 volumes count against it. A new 150K IOPS volume needs at least 150,000 available, and more if you already have io2 volumes.
- Your io2 storage quota is 20 TiB. A large io2 volume could hit that limit next, so check it too.

**What to do**
1. **Request a quota increase.** Ask for the io2 IOPS quota (code `L-8D977E7E`) to be raised in the Region where you're creating the volume. Set it to at least your target volume plus all existing io2 IOPS. Leave some headroom, for example 300,000 if you expect to add more volumes. You can submit the request in the Service Quotas console, or I can submit it for you here. It needs your approval first.
2. **Check your volume config against io2 limits** while you wait:
   - io2 Block Express supports up to 256,000 IOPS per volume, so 150K is allowed.
   - You can provision up to 1,000 IOPS per GiB, so a 150K IOPS volume needs at least 150 GiB.
   - Only Nitro-based instances can use more than 64,000 IOPS. Other instance types can attach to the volume but top out at much lower performance.
3. **Workarounds if you can't wait for approval:** lower the IOPS to fit under 100K, or reduce IOPS on other io2 volumes. Stripe several smaller volumes if that suits your workload. Increases are often approved quickly but not instantly.

Do you want me to submit the increase request? If so, tell me the Region and the target value. If you're not sure of the target, I can total your existing io2 IOPS to help you pick it.", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
